title: Name a whole number
summary: Fortran: Name a whole number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: integer declares a whole-number value. The I0 format prints it without leading padding.
learningObjectives: Name a whole number with Fortran

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Name a whole number
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: pencils = 3
write(*,'(I0)') pencils + 2
end program lesson

blocks.text: The integer variable holds 3. I0 prints the sum 5 without width padding.
